subject: reasoning
question:
Which letter-cluster will replace the question mark (?) to complete the given series?

UTHS, VRKO, ?, XNQG, YLTC
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic: 

First and third letters → (1) and (3) are added to the position values according to the English alphabetic series respectively.

Second and fourth letters → (2) and (4) are subtracted from the position values according to the English alphabetic series respectively.

​​So,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4e6b21d9efa8324a9d0aad39acd3f6e9181a848037bd8a529790ba7732b19ea0.png] ​

Hence, "Option - (4)" is the correct answer.
